desc.factoryascent.quern: Hand-cranked millstone: grinds raw ore into dust (1 + 50% chance of a second). Sneak + right-click or use the Crank button.
desc.factoryascent.brick_kiln: Fuel-fired kiln that alloys copper and tin into bronze.
desc.factoryascent.burner_crusher: Fuel-powered crusher: 2 dust per raw ore.
desc.factoryascent.burner_press: Fuel-powered press: plates, gears, rods and wires depending on the mould.
desc.factoryascent.coke_oven: Multiblock controller: bakes coal into coke (and logs into charcoal). Needs no fuel.
desc.factoryascent.blast_furnace: Multiblock controller: turns iron into steel, burning coke.
desc.factoryascent.electric_furnace: Smelts anything a furnace can, five times faster, plus aluminium.
desc.factoryascent.crusher: 2 dust per raw ore (3 per ore block) plus a chance of a byproduct.
desc.factoryascent.metal_press: Fast electric press. The mould decides what it makes.
desc.factoryascent.alloy_smelter: Alloys bronze, steel and silicon quickly.
desc.factoryascent.assembler: Builds circuits, motors and machine frames from parts.
desc.factoryascent.solar_panel: 8 FE/t in daylight under open sky (half in rain).
desc.factoryascent.auto_farmer: Harvests ripe crops in a 9×9 field in front of it and replants them.
desc.factoryascent.energy_cell: Stores energy. Charges items in its slot.
desc.factoryascent.miner: Claims its own chunk in The Deep, a sealed mining dimension, and digs out its ore.
desc.factoryascent.geothermal_generator: 24 FE/t for every lava source touching it. The lava is never used up.
desc.factoryascent.ore_washer: Washes raw ore into 3 dust (4 from ore blocks), with a better byproduct chance.
desc.factoryascent.induction_smelter: Induction heating: the only smelter hot enough for titanium. Also smelts anything a furnace can, very fast.
desc.factoryascent.hydraulic_press: Presses titanium into plates and gears. The mould decides what it makes.
desc.factoryascent.precision_assembler: Clean-room assembler for spacecraft parts such as the Orbital Targeting Core.
desc.factoryascent.plasma_forge: Forges quantum alloy in a plasma arc: the way into the Quantum age.
tooltip.factoryascent.miner_radius: Claim: %s×%s chunk column in The Deep
tooltip.factoryascent.generation_per_lav: Generates %s FE/t per touching lava source
tooltip.factoryascent.cell_front: Power comes OUT of the lightning-bolt face and goes IN through every other face. Right-click a side with a Wrench to make it the output. The slot charges tools
tooltip.factoryascent.cable_bottleneck: A network runs at the rate of its slowest cable
tooltip.factoryascent.pipe_rate: Pulls up to %s items/s per extracting face
tooltip.factoryascent.pipe_hint: Wrench a face touching an inventory to pull from it
tooltip.factoryascent.crate: Holds %s stacks and keeps them when broken
tooltip.factoryascent.multiblock.coke_ov: Multiblock: controller at the bottom centre of the front of a 3×3×3 cube of Coke Oven Bricks
tooltip.factoryascent.multiblock.blast_f: Multiblock: controller at the bottom centre of the front of a 3×3×3 cube of Fire Bricks with a hollow centre
tooltip.factoryascent.upgrade_slots: Fits in the upgrade slots of electric machines
tooltip.factoryascent.mold: Press mould: decides what a press makes. Never used up.
tooltip.factoryascent.forge_hammer: Craft with 2 ingots to make a plate
tooltip.factoryascent.wrench: Rotates machines; sets an Energy Cell's output face; toggles item pipe faces between insert and extract
tooltip.factoryascent.electric_drill: Mines faster than netherite while charged. Charge it in an Energy Cell. 100 FE per block.
gui.factoryascent.crank_hint: Click (or sneak + right-click the Quern) to turn it
gui.factoryascent.hide_accepts: Hide the list of accepted items
gui.factoryascent.see_panel: See the list on the left for what it accepts
gui.factoryascent.jei_needs_long: Needs a %s or a better machine of the same kind
gui.factoryascent.jei_needs_later_long: Needs a grade %s machine, unlocked in a later age
gui.factoryascent.not_accepted: This machine has no recipe for this item
gui.factoryascent.see_recipes: Click ? (top right) to see what it accepts
advancements.factoryascent.root.title: Factory Ascent
advancements.factoryascent.root.descript: Seven ages from a hand mill to the stars.
Craft a Forge Hammer and hammer 2 ingots into a plate
advancements.factoryascent.stone_quern.d: Build a Quern. Put raw ore in and turn the crank to get dust
advancements.factoryascent.stone_dust.de: Grind raw ore into dust and smelt it. Dust can give bonus ingots
advancements.factoryascent.stone_tin.des: Find tin ore (pale specks, common underground)
advancements.factoryascent.stone_kiln.de: Build a Brick Kiln to alloy 3 copper + 1 tin
advancements.factoryascent.age_bronze.de: Breakthrough! Make your first bronze ingot
advancements.factoryascent.bronze_crushe: Build a Burner Crusher: 2 dust from every raw ore
Build a Burner Press and a mould to make plates, gears, rods and wires
advancements.factoryascent.bronze_coke.d: Build a Coke Oven (3×3×3 of Coke Oven Bricks) and bake coal into coke
advancements.factoryascent.bronze_logist: Make Bronze Item Pipes (or a Bronze Crate). Wrench a pipe face to pull from a chest
Breakthrough! Build the Blast Furnace (3×3×3 Fire Bricks, hollow) and make steel
advancements.factoryascent.electric_fram: Craft a Machine Frame from steel plates
advancements.factoryascent.electric_powe: Build a Combustion Generator and connect machines with Copper Cable
advancements.factoryascent.electric_circ: Breakthrough! Assemble your first Basic Circuit: every electric machine needs one
advancements.factoryascent.electric_crus: Build an electric Crusher or Electric Furnace
advancements.factoryascent.electric_dril: Craft an Electric Drill and charge it in an Energy Cell
advancements.factoryascent.electric_farm: Build an Auto-Farmer: it harvests and replants a 9×9 field
advancements.factoryascent.electric_stor: Build a Storage Network: controller, drive with cells, and a terminal
advancements.factoryascent.electric_alum: Smelt bauxite into aluminium in the Electric Furnace
advancements.factoryascent.electric_sili: Alloy quartz dust and coal dust into silicon, then press it into wafers
advancements.factoryascent.automation_mi: Build an Ore Miner: it digs ore out of its own claim in The Deep
advancements.factoryascent.automation_ge: Build a Geothermal Generator next to lava
advancements.factoryascent.automation_wa: Build an Ore Washer: 3 dust from every raw ore
advancements.factoryascent.automation_in: Build an Induction Smelter, the only furnace hot enough for titanium
advancements.factoryascent.age_industria: Breakthrough! Smelt titanium in an Induction Smelter
advancements.factoryascent.industrial_pr: Build a Hydraulic Press and press titanium plates
Build a Precision Assembler for spacecraft parts
advancements.factoryascent.age_orbital.d: Breakthrough! Assemble an Orbital Targeting Core
advancements.factoryascent.age_quantum.d: Breakthrough! Forge quantum alloy in the Plasma Forge
advancements.factoryascent.electric_anch: Build an Ender Anchor (a stasis chamber of glass, water and soul sand) and drop a pearl in
advancements.factoryascent.electric_reca: Load an Ender Beacon with a pearl, link a Recall Charm to it, and channel your way home
advancements.factoryascent.automation_mo: Craft a Mob Capsule: hold right-click on a mob for 3 s to trap it
advancements.factoryascent.automation_si: Craft a Minimizer or Maximizer Ray to resize any creature
advancements.factoryascent.orbital_pad.d: Build a Launch Pad: a Launch Controller surrounded by 8 Launch Pad blocks
advancements.factoryascent.orbital_stati: Build a Ground Station and use an empty map on it to map the area from orbit
advancements.factoryascent.orbital_wirel: Link a Wireless Terminal to a Storage Terminal and open it from anywhere with signal
desc.factoryascent.storage_cable: Joins storage devices into one network
desc.factoryascent.storage_controller: Powers a storage network. Exactly one per network
desc.factoryascent.storage_terminal: Search, take and store everything in the network
desc.factoryascent.storage_interface: Lets pipes and hoppers insert into and extract from the network
advancements.factoryascent.storage_netwo: Craft a Storage Controller: the heart of a centralized storage network
tooltip.factoryascent.ender_anchor: A stasis chamber: keeps a %s×%s area of chunks loaded
tooltip.factoryascent.ender_anchor_pearl: Right-click with an ender pearl to start it. It runs until broken; breaking it loses the pearl
tooltip.factoryascent.ender_beacon: A stasis chamber your Recall Charm can trigger from anywhere. Sneak-use a charm on it to link
tooltip.factoryascent.ender_beacon_pearl: Right-click with an ender pearl to load it. Each recall uses the pearl up
tooltip.factoryascent.charm_unlinked: Not linked: sneak-use it on an Ender Beacon
tooltip.factoryascent.charm_howto: Hold use for %s s to recall home. Taking damage breaks the channel

message.factoryascent.beacon_loaded: A pearl is waiting: ready for a recall
message.factoryascent.beacon_empty: Empty: load an ender pearl to be able to recall here

message.factoryascent.charm_no_pearl: Your Ender Beacon has no pearl loaded
tooltip.factoryascent.mob_capsule: Hold right-click on a mob for 3 s to trap it. Keep looking at it and stay close. Right-click a block to release.
tooltip.factoryascent.mob_capsule.releas: Right-click a block to release it.
tooltip.factoryascent.minimizer_ray: Shrinks any creature: smaller mobs fit through 1-block gaps and are easier to move. Maximizer undoes it.
tooltip.factoryascent.maximizer_ray: Grows any creature, up to 4× its size. Also undoes the Minimizer.
tooltip.factoryascent.size_ray.usage: Hold right-click for 1 s to charge, release to fire (%s FE per shot, 24 blocks).

message.factoryascent.mob_capsule.failed: Capture failed: too far away (6 blocks max)
Capture failed: the creature is gone
message.factoryascent.mob_capsule.refuse: Only living mobs can be captured
%s is too powerful to be captured
Can't capture %s while it rides or is ridden
message.factoryascent.size_ray.no_energy: Not enough energy (%s FE per shot)
advancements.factoryascent.orbital_launc: Fuel a rocket, mount a satellite and launch it into orbit
advancements.factoryascent.orbital_uplin: Put an Uplink Satellite in orbit: your team has signal in the whole dimension
tooltip.factoryascent.launch_pad: Eight of these around a Launch Controller make the 3×3 Launch Pad
tooltip.factoryascent.launch_controller: Centre of the 3×3 Launch Pad: mount a satellite, fuel it, launch it
tooltip.factoryascent.launch_controller_: Needs %s fuel per launch (Blaze Powder 1, Rocket Fuel 4). Launch with redstone or sneak-use flint and steel
Multiblock: surround it with 8 Launch Pad blocks

tooltip.factoryascent.survey_satellite: In orbit: Ground Stations in this dimension make filled maps of their area
tooltip.factoryascent.uplink_satellite: In orbit: your team has signal everywhere in this dimension (Wireless Terminal)
tooltip.factoryascent.satellite_launch: Mount it on a Launch Pad. It covers the dimension it is launched from. Rename it in an anvil to name it
tooltip.factoryascent.wireless_unlinked: Not linked: sneak-use it on a Storage Terminal
tooltip.factoryascent.wireless_needs_upl: Works anywhere in the same dimension with uplink coverage, while the terminal's chunk is loaded

message.factoryascent.wireless_gone: The linked Storage Terminal is gone
